articles.title: Netflix Wanted to Reinvent Live TV. It Hasn’t Been Easy.
articles.mainIdea: Netflix Wanted to Reinvent Live TV. It Hasn’t Been Easy.
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Netflix Wanted to Reinvent Live TV. It Hasn’t Been Easy.. After some very public glitches, Netflix thinks it has cracked the code on the tech needed to stream live events. Executives say it has been harder than anticipated. Related tickers mentioned: NFLX.
